full_prompt_en: A square landscape oil painting shows a wet winding path through open marshland beneath a dramatic, broken storm sky. A large dark tree stands on the left, its irregular crown bending over the scene and silhouetted against a bright opening in the clouds. The foreground begins with a pale reflective strip of path or shallow water that curves from the lower left toward the distant center. Rough grasses and brown-green reeds crowd its edges, their tips catching small accents of warm light. Beyond them, flat fields extend to a low horizon, where a thin distant line of trees separates earth from sky. The upper half is dominated by heavy blue-gray clouds, their dark undersides lifted by cream and silver breaks of daylight. A few small birds cross the opening near the center-right, tiny marks that emphasize the scale of the sky. The tree trunk and nearby shrubs are built from rough dark strokes, while the wet path has smoother, broken reflections and the distant fields flatten into soft bands. A cool breeze seems implied by the slanted foliage and shifting cloud masses, but no people or buildings interrupt the open space. Light comes through the cloud gap above the central horizon, grazing the grass and laying a pale sheen along the path; the left tree remains largely in shadow. Olive, umber, silver, slate blue, and cream create a restrained natural palette. The overall composition leads the eye along the luminous curve from a dark sheltered foreground into the broad, changeable distance.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形风景油画描绘一条潮湿蜿蜒小径穿过开阔沼泽，上方是戏剧性裂开的暴风天空。左侧一棵大深色树立着，不规则树冠弯向画面，在明亮云隙前形成剪影。前景由一带浅色反光小路或浅水开始，从左下弯向远处中央。粗糙草丛和棕绿芦苇挤在两侧，尖端接住少量暖色亮点。其后平坦田地延伸至低地平线，一道细远树线将土地与天空分开。上半部由沉重蓝灰云主导，深色云底被奶油与银色日光裂缝抬亮。几只小鸟掠过中央偏右的开口，微小笔画强调天空尺度。树干和近处灌丛由粗重深色笔触构成，湿小径带更平滑破碎的倒影，远处田地则变成柔和色带。倾斜枝叶和变化的云团暗示冷风，但没有人物或建筑打断开阔空间。光透过中央地平线上方的云隙进入，掠过草丛，并沿小径铺下一层浅色光泽；左树大多仍处于阴影。橄榄绿、深褐、银、石板蓝和奶油色组成克制自然色域。整体构图引导目光沿明亮曲线，从深色庇护的前景走入宽广多变的远方。
style_prompt_en: The image has a nineteenth-century oil-paint finish, with broken natural brushwork and expansive atmospheric fields. Olive, umber, slate blue, silver, and cream shift gently through cool and warm areas. Dark irregular masses anchor one side of the frame, opening onto broad low bands and a luminous distant gap. Near textures are rough and stippled, while distant boundaries and soft masses soften into layered, sweeping strokes. Diffuse light breaks through darker overhead forms, catching selected edges and wet-looking patches without making the scene uniformly bright. A curving pale line moves through the lower field toward a distant focal point. The overall effect is weathered, contemplative, and quietly dramatic.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有十九世纪油画质感，带破碎自然笔触和开阔大气色域。橄榄绿、深褐、石板蓝、银与奶油色在冷暖区域中柔和变化。深色不规则体量稳住画面一侧，向宽阔低平色带和明亮远处开口敞开。近处肌理粗糙且带点描，远处边界与柔软体量则柔化成层叠横扫笔触。漫射光穿透较暗的头顶形态，照亮选定边缘和似潮湿的色斑，却不让场景均匀明亮。一道弯曲浅色线穿过下部，通向远处焦点。整体效果风化、沉思且安静地富有戏剧性。
theme_en: A wet path through marshland beneath a stormy sky
theme_zh: 暴风云下穿过沼泽的湿润小径
name: David Cox
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
